acceptance_criteria: The resolved plan exposes plan version, Profile version/hash, API version, and the normalized input semantic digest.
Equivalent YAML and JSON encodings produce an equal semantic digest even though their source byte hashes differ.
Changing only a resource revision or artifact/model revision does not change an unrelated version field.
applicability: Phase 1 XDL Lite bounded software allocation (offline declared experiment intent compilation). status 'accepted' records internal engineering intent only; it is not implementation satisfaction or external delivery acceptance.
statement: The compiler shall record the exact declared input provenance - normalized source hashes plus an input semantic digest - in the resolved plan, so that a downstream consumer can verify plan, Profile, and API versions and normalized source hashes without reparsing YAML, and shall keep the schema version, resource revision, Profile version, and artifact/model revision independent.
title: Declared input provenance and independent versions
verification_intent: Planned to be exercised through the XDL1-UNIT, XDL1-STATIC, XDL1-INTEGRATION, and XDL1-VALIDATION measures defined in the XDL1 verification-design stage, invoking the real loader, schema registry, catalog, activation-plan consumer, and additive CLI/API. No runtime, availability, compatibility, or readiness claim is made.
